panels.title: Scientific Model Card & Survival Analysis Context

options.content:
**Core:** `stockout_survival_v1` | **Model Architecture:** `Cox Proportional Hazards Model with L2 Regularization`
**Time Horizon:** 7-Day continuous evaluation study with administrative right-censoring at Day 7 (3,797 test episodes).
> ⚠️ **Kaplan-Meier Semantics:** Empirical survival step functions are calculated directly from duration_days and depletion events. Administrative censoring ends the study at Day 7.

panels.title: Concordance Index (C-Index)
panels.description: Harrell's C-index measuring ranking concordance of survival times

targets.rawSql: SELECT cast(test::json->>'concordance_index' as float) FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_metrics LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Mean 3-Day Depletion-Free Rate
panels.description: Average cohort probability of maintaining stock availability through Day 3

panels.title: Mean 7-Day Depletion-Free Rate
panels.description: Average cohort probability of maintaining stock availability through Day 7

panels.title: Empirical Kaplan–Meier Survival Step Function (Days 0 to 7)
panels.description: Empirical Kaplan-Meier survival step function across the 7-day study horizon derived from duration_days and survival_event

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (    SELECT generate_series(0, 7) as day), events AS (    SELECT duration_days::int as day, sum(case when survival_event then 1 else 0 end) as events, count(*) as removed     FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions GROUP BY duration_days::int), timeline AS (    SELECT d.day, coalesce(e.events, 0) as events, coalesce(e.removed, 0) as removed,            (SELECT count(*) FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions) - coalesce(sum(e.removed) over (order by d.day rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding), 0) as at_risk     FROM days d LEFT JOIN events e ON d.day = e.day) SELECT day, case when day = 0 then 100.0 else round((exp(sum(ln(case when events = 0 then 1.0 else (1.0 - events::numeric / at_risk) end)) over (order by day rows between unbounded preceding and current row)) * 100)::numeric, 2) end as km_survival_pct FROM timeline ORDER BY day ASC;

panels.title: Stratified Kaplan–Meier Survival by Hazard Risk Cohort
panels.description: Empirical survival trajectory divergence comparing elevated hazard positions against baseline low-hazard stock

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS (    SELECT case when risk_score > 1.0 then 'Elevated Hazard (Risk > 1.0)' else 'Baseline / Low Hazard (Risk <= 1.0)' end as risk_group,            duration_days::int as day, survival_event     FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions), totals AS (    SELECT risk_group, count(*) as total_cohort FROM base GROUP BY risk_group), days AS (    SELECT d.day, t.risk_group, t.total_cohort FROM generate_series(0, 7) d(day) CROSS JOIN totals t), events AS (    SELECT risk_group, day, sum(case when survival_event then 1 else 0 end) as events, count(*) as removed FROM base GROUP BY risk_group, day), timeline AS (    SELECT d.risk_group, d.day, coalesce(e.events, 0) as events, coalesce(e.removed, 0) as removed,            d.total_cohort - coalesce(sum(e.removed) over (partition by d.risk_group order by d.day rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding), 0) as at_risk     FROM days d LEFT JOIN events e ON d.risk_group = e.risk_group AND d.day = e.day), km AS (    SELECT day, risk_group, case when day = 0 then 100.0 else round((exp(sum(ln(case when events = 0 then 1.0 else (1.0 - events::numeric / at_risk) end)) over (partition by risk_group order by day rows between unbounded preceding and current row)) * 100)::numeric, 2) end as km_survival_pct     FROM timeline) SELECT day, max(case when risk_group like 'Baseline%' then km_survival_pct end) as "Low Hazard Cohort (Risk <= 1.0)",        max(case when risk_group like 'Elevated%' then km_survival_pct end) as "Elevated Hazard Cohort (Risk > 1.0)" FROM km GROUP BY day ORDER BY day ASC;

panels.title: Cox Hazard Model Feature Log-Hazard Coefficients
panels.description: Log-hazard ratio coefficients indicating risk accelerators (>0) and protective buffers (<0)

targets.rawSql: SELECT feature, round(coef::numeric, 3) as log_hazard_coefficient FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_coefficients ORDER BY coef DESC;

panels.title: Multi-Horizon Predicted Survival Probability Decay
panels.description: Cohort mean predicted survival probability decay across discrete horizons

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Day 3 Horizon' as horizon, round((avg(survival_probability_day_3) * 100)::numeric, 2) as "Predicted Survival Rate (%)" FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions UNION ALL SELECT 'Day 5 Horizon', round((avg(survival_probability_day_5) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions UNION ALL SELECT 'Day 7 Horizon', round((avg(survival_probability_day_7) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Average 7-Day Survival Probability by Warehouse
panels.description: Geographic fulfillment comparison across 7-day survival rates

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat('Warehouse ', warehouse_id) as warehouse, round((avg(survival_probability_day_7) * 100)::numeric, 1) as avg_7d_survival_pct FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Depletion Risk Score Tier Distribution
panels.description: Inventory cohort segmented into operational risk urgency categories

targets.rawSql: SELECT case when risk_score < 0.5 then 'Moderate Risk (< 0.5)' when risk_score < 1.0 then 'Elevated Risk (0.5 - 1.0)' else 'Critical Depletion Risk (> 1.0)' end as risk_tier, count(*) as episode_count FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(risk_score) ASC;

panels.title: Highest-Risk Survival Episodes & Depletion Curves
panels.description: Top prioritized inventory positions with full 3-day, 5-day, and 7-day survival probability projections

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(prediction_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as date, warehouse_id, sku_id, round(risk_score::numeric, 2) as hazard_score, round((survival_probability_day_3 * 100)::numeric, 1) as prob_day_3_pct, round((survival_probability_day_5 * 100)::numeric, 1) as prob_day_5_pct, round((survival_probability_day_7 * 100)::numeric, 1) as prob_day_7_pct, available_quantity, round(sales_velocity_7d::numeric, 2) as velocity_7d FROM ml_results.stockout_survival_v1_predictions ORDER BY risk_score DESC LIMIT 200;
